status: Plan only; no hardware connected, powered or measured
purpose: Close assembly, stiffness and fast-tracking uncertainty with the smallest representative build before buying20motors.

record: actual screw head diameter/height and length
stage0.not_allowed_assumption: Do not infer head dimensions from M2thread designation. Supplied M2x4 frame screws are not long enough for this5mm printed interface.

reference_machine_screw.note: Manufacturer maximum screw tightening torque is not a validated clamping torque for the printed interface.

stage1.option_A: OneMCPservo+stockS101/H101 with an independently weighed load fixture. Fit both first moment and inertia; include fixture/weights own inertia.
stage1.option_B: Onecomplete middle finger:4M077,4S101,4H101,onecartridge,oneCompact_root,twoFlex_links,onetip. Fix spread/PIP/DIP at the measured Open angles and test MCP. This directly reproduces the actual mass distribution.
stage1.interpretation: About84g with center101mm from axis matches the point-mass lower-bound screen only when fixture and other hardware mass/inertia are zero. Subtract real fixture contributions and add each weight intrinsic inertia. A short50mm heavy load matching static torque alone is not dynamically representative.

fixture_matching_equations.single_point_solution: r = I_remaining / S_remaining; m = S_remaining^2 / I_remaining
fixture_matching_equations.checks: Keep positive remaining mass/inertia; use2Dfirst moment if COM not on the intended lever. Intrinsic and reflected motor inertia still need measurement.

stage2_static_sag.purpose: Measure static gravity/load sag in one XL330 root-joint module before fitting the actuator model or changing CAD. The current simulator is a PD/PWM/current proxy without an integral term, not the measured internal servo PID.

observed_simulation_issue.note: Old90paths/40sag failures belong to the previous small/remote model. NewV9geometry has no calibrated torque tracking result.

keep_identical: load application and goal approach direction
fixed_conditions.joint_coordinate_mapping: Record hardware zero offset and encoder direction; Mode 5 uses signed multi-turn position, so do not wrap errors at 360deg.

position_i.internal_conversion: K_I = register/65536; not an SI torque-integral gain

gains.mode_switch_note: Switching Operating Mode resets gains and limits, including Position PID/PWM Limit for Mode 5. Read back after the mode switch. Do not assume the generic control-table initial P/D values are the actual Mode 5 baseline.

profiles.setup: Use actual Mode 5 default P and D readbacks. Record the initial I readback and any explicit change to I=0.
Select one stable positive I value at zero/0.02Nm first; record its raw readback. Use that same value across all B load trials.

gains.positive_i_selection: Begin with a small positive value and increase gradually on the secured low-load fixture. Compare residual error, settling, oscillation, load-release overshoot and current saturation. The final I value is not specified before measurement.
gains.comparison_rule: Change only Position I Gain between A and B; avoid switching operating mode between these profiles. Archive readbacks and restore the baseline settings after testing.

loading.fixture: A rigid single-joint root module with representative downstream mass or a calibrated load arm. Keep fingers/pads free of contact.
loading.torque_measurement: Use independently known force/weight and the actual perpendicular lever arm; tau = m*9.80665*r_perp. Record fixture/downstream gravity torque separately. Do not infer applied load torque from Present Current.
loading.example_note: Mass values are examples at a 50mm perpendicular arm, not additional loads to apply automatically. Recompute the perpendicular arm after rotation.
loading.sequence: For each goal and repetition, measure unloaded reference, apply each signed torque, hold, unload and record release response. Alternate A/B trial order across repetitions to expose drift; use the same approach direction. Opposite load directions expose backlash/hysteresis.

steady_window_criteria.note: Initial analysis settings, adjustable after inspecting the data; not manufacturer specifications or a physical-clearance acceptance limit.

acquisition.optional_external_link_angle: An independent link-angle measurement can separate servo position error from bracket/horn compliance and backlash.

errors.signed_error_deg: goal_joint_deg - actual_joint_deg; apply calibrated encoder sign/zero
errors.loaded_sag_deg: mean loaded signed error minus the mean of unloaded-before and unloaded-after errors

acquisition.saturation_policy: Mark suspected current/PWM limiting, unsettled trials, hardware faults and large voltage/temperature changes. Preserve all logs; exclude saturated/unsettled trials from an unconstrained static-stiffness fit. Do not attribute saturation error to missing integral gain.

required_trial_metadata: mode and full P/I/D readbacks after switching
calibrated joint zero and encoder direction
fixture mass/COM and actual lever arm
goal angle, load sign and repetition
analysis_and_model_update: Compare A versus B at identical goal, torque sign and magnitude; summarize signed mean error, variation, settling, release overshoot, current and temperature.

Use A's unloaded-subtracted error versus independently measured load torque to fit effective static stiffness/friction/hysteresis over the measured range. Do not copy DYNAMIXEL register gains directly into the simulator.
If B is selected, model its measured integral response and current-limited recovery/anti-windup behavior using the time series; changing only a constant bias is insufficient.

Record the measurement files, firmware and chosen gains with the calibrated model. Test the measured parameter range and uncertainty, then rerun new CAD motion cases and actual surface-clearance checks.
Treat real sag as unmeasured; after fitting, rerun actual new CAD collision checks under tracking and deformation uncertainty.

source.scope: Register facts are documented; loads, repetition counts and analysis windows are this project's test design.

stage3_dynamic.start: Low speed, no contact; verify calibrated encoder sign and software limits before moves.
profiles: Smooth30/60/90deg flexion with generous initial duration then gradually shorter commands
Both motion directions, horizontal/vertical palm orientations
Record actual human tracking trajectory; replay1.0x then1.5x only after prior test stays within limits
record: goal and measured joint angle with monotonic timestamps
saturation,gear backlash,printed bracket flex and vibration
stage3_dynamic.acceptance: Compare measured response with the user target trace, not unloaded RPM. No fixed pass speed declared until a target human trace and actual fixture are measured.
no_automatic_changes: Do not raise current to1.2A as an untested cure
Do not remove DIP motors from the baseline design without reviewing the candidate mechanism
Do not copy legacy90paths or old250ms results into this CAD
